name: transfer_demo
description: Open the Transfer Funds page and transfer 100 dollars from account 13344 to account 13566

approved_plan.goal: Open the Transfer Funds page and transfer 100 dollars from account 13344 to account 13566

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay parabank_login@1.0.0 using the supplied username and password

steps.intent: Navigate to the Transfer Funds page
steps.action: Click the 'Transfer Funds' link in the authenticated navigation menu

steps.intent: Fill in the transfer form: enter the amount, select the from-account and the to-account, then submit
steps.action: Set the amount field to the supplied transfer_amount, select from_account_id as the source account, select to_account_id as the destination account, and click the Transfer button

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: from_account_id
parameters.description: The account number to transfer funds from

parameters.name: to_account_id
parameters.description: The account number to transfer funds to

approved_plan.success_signal: A confirmation heading or message such as "Transfer Complete!" is displayed on the page after the transfer is submitted

business_outcomes.description: One or both of the specified accounts do not exist or are not accessible to the authenticated user.
The source account does not have sufficient funds to cover the requested transfer amount.
The username or password supplied was not accepted by ParaBank and the user could not be logged in.

when.value: The username and password could not be verified.

then.message: ParaBank rejected the supplied credentials. Verify username and password inputs and retry with correct values.
ParaBank returned HTTP 503 on navigation. The application server may be down or unreachable; investigate infrastructure before retrying.
The ParaBank entry page returned 404. The base URL or deployment path may be misconfigured.

when.value: An internal error has occurred and has been logged.

then.message: ParaBank reported an internal error when attempting the transfer, most likely because the from_account_id or to_account_id does not exist or is not owned by this user.
The source account (from_account_id) does not have enough funds to cover the requested transfer_amount.
The transfer amount was rejected by ParaBank. Ensure transfer_amount is a positive number greater than zero.
